title: Documentation Added for High-Value Vehicles on a Keyturn Host Protection Plan Report
content:
A vehicle the marketplace values highly carries more documentation on a damage report under the Keyturn Host Protection Plan, and how much more turns on who holds the title to it.

The marketplace's high-value documentation mark is 40000. Where the marketplace's valuation of the vehicle reaches that mark and the title of the vehicle is held by a lienholder or a lessor, the high-value financed addition of 4 documents is added to the count. Where that valuation reaches the mark and the title is held outright, the high-value owned addition of 2 documents is added. Where the valuation does not reach the mark, nothing is added on that account.

### Both sides of the mark

| Marketplace valuation | Title | Added |
|---|---|---|
| 40000 or more | held by a lienholder or a lessor | 4 |
| 40000 or more | held outright | 2 |
| below 40000 | either | nothing |

A valuation of exactly 40000 reaches the mark; one of 39999 does not, and nothing is added on that account whoever holds the title.

### The record the reading is taken from

The marketplace's valuation of the vehicle and the status of its title are read from the Keyturn Vehicle Listing standing for that vehicle. A title held outright is a clean title; a title held by a lienholder or a lessor is one recorded as financed or leased.
